cases.sentence: В последние дни гора Дома Господня станет высочайшую среди ___, вознесется она над холмами.
cases.translation: But in the latter days, the mountain of the Lord's temple will be the highest among the mountains.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.
The verb устремятся (will stream, will rush to) is used with the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Многие ___  пойдут и скажут 'Идем, поднимемся на Господню гору'.
cases.translation: Many nations will go and say, 'Let us go up to the mountain of the Lord.'
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb пойдут (will go), which requires the nominative plural.

cases.sentence: Ведь из Сиона выйдет закон, и слово Господне из ___.
cases.translation: For the law will go out of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of, from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он рассудит меж многими ___, разрешит тяжбы сильных племен в далеких краях.
cases.translation: He will judge between many peoples and will decide concerning strong nations far away.
cases.explain: The preposition меж (among) and the adverbial genitive construction governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Перекуют они мечи на плуги и копья на ___.
cases.translation: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
cases.explain: The verb перекуют (will forge) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Каждый будет сидеть под своей виноградной лозой и под своим ___.
cases.translation: Each one will sit under his own vine and fig tree, and no one will make them afraid.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with the instrumental case indicates the location where one sits.

cases.sentence: Мечься и стони, дочь Сиона, как женщина при ___.
cases.translation: Be in pain and give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor.
cases.explain: The preposition при (at, during) governs the prepositional case родах.

reading.ru: В последние дни гора Дома Господня станет высочайшую среди гор, вознесется она над холмами и устремятся к ней народы.
reading.question: What will happen to the mountain of the Lord's house in the last days?
options: It will be the highest among the mountains and peoples will stream to it
It will be hidden from sight
It will become a burial place
reading.correct: It will be the highest among the mountains and peoples will stream to it
reading.explain: The text says the mountain will 'станет высочайшую среди гор' and 'устремятся к ней народы' (become the highest and peoples will stream to it).

reading.ru: Ведь из Сиона выйдет закон, и слово Господне из Иерусалима.
reading.question: Where will God's law and word come from?
reading.explain: The text states 'из Сиона выйдет закон, и слово Господне из Иерусалима' (the law will go out of Zion and the Lord's word from Jerusalem).

reading.ru: Перекуют они мечи на плуги и копья на серпы. Не поднимет народ на народ меча, и не будут больше учиться войне.
reading.question: What does the text say about weapons and war?
options: Swords will be beaten into plowshares and nations will not wage war anymore
Only the rich will have weapons
War will be taught in schools
reading.correct: Swords will be beaten into plowshares and nations will not wage war anymore
reading.explain: The text states 'Перекуют они мечи на плуги' and 'Не поднимет народ на народ меча' (they will beat swords into plowshares and no nation will lift sword against nation).

reading.ru: Каждый будет сидеть под своей виноградной лозой и под своим инжиром, и некого им будет бояться.
reading.question: What will be the result of this peace?
options: Each person will sit under their own vine and fig tree with nothing to fear
reading.correct: Each person will sit under their own vine and fig tree with nothing to fear
reading.explain: The text says 'Каждый будет сидеть под своей виноградной лозой и под своим инжиром, и некого им будет бояться' (each will sit under his vine and fig tree with nothing to fear).

reading.ru: Я непременно соберу всего тебя, Иаков. Соберу воедино уцелевших у Израиля.
reading.question: What does God promise for Jacob and Israel?
options: To surely gather all of Jacob and the remnant of Israel
reading.correct: To surely gather all of Jacob and the remnant of Israel
reading.explain: God says 'Я непременно соберу всего тебя, Иаков' (I will surely gather all of Jacob).

reading.ru: Господь будет править ими с горы Сион с того дня и вовек.
reading.question: How long will the Lord rule over His people?
options: From Mount Zion forever and ever
reading.correct: From Mount Zion forever and ever
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь будет править ими с горы Сион с того дня и вовек' (the Lord will reign over them from Mount Zion from that day onward, forever).
